member_id.description: Reference to Member entity (null if guest)

guest_id.description: Reference to MemberGroupGuest entity (null if member)

group_role.description: Role within the group (from the group's roles array)

expires_at.description: Optional expiry date for this assignment

is_group_admin.description: Whether this person is explicitly designated as a group admin for the group

term_length_value.description: Snapshot of the role's term length value at award/invite-accept time (e.g. 3). Fixed — not affected by later role edits.

term_length_unit.description: Snapshot of the role's term length unit at award/invite-accept time ('months' or 'years').

max_terms.description: Snapshot of the role's maximum number of terms at award/invite-accept time.

term_start_date.description: When this term began (award/invite-accept date). Tracked separately from expires_at.

term_end_date.description: Projected end date for this term (term_start_date + term length). Display-only; not enforced.

term_number.description: Which term the member is currently serving for this role in this group (e.g. 1 means 'Term 1 of max_terms').

assignment_source.description: How this assignment was created: manual (admin UI), self_join (member self-joined), or automatic (automatic membership rule).
